'''Emilia''' is a female [[NPC]] from [[Lilyland]], touring [[Septimont]]. She can be found in front of the [[Leonidas Hotel]] in [[Capitoline Hill City]] with [[Silvanus]] during the day.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Day)
:;'''Silvanus''' And with that, we Beasts Beneath are invincible! 
:;'''Emilia''' Oh, yes... You truly get really excited when it comes to topics about gladiating.

:'''Emilia''' Where on earth is the entrance...?
:'''Silvanus''' Greetings, madam! May applause greet you! What seems to be the trouble? Just let me know and I'll have it taken care of right away!
:'''Emilia''' Thank you, kind sir. I am from Lilyland. This is my first time visiting the Agon, and I don't know where to entrance is...
:'''Silvanus''' Ah, I see! Then please allow me to escort you inside. I can also give you an introduction to the tournament, especially my favorite team, Beasts Beneath!
:'''Emilia''' Wonderful! You're too kind!
----
;(Night)
:'''Emilia''' You see, Septimont is truly a beautiful city.
:'''Emilia''' This fervency reminds me of the theater back home.
:'''Emilia''' Did you know that in my hometown of Lilyland, there is a huge stage surrounded by a field of flowers?
:'''Emilia''' At the end of each performance, the crowd showers the actors with flower petals to show their appreciation.
:'''Emilia''' I get the same feeling from Septimont as well. When a match concludes, the audience cheers and applauds. The energy. The excitement.
{{Dialogue End}}
